WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
  SELECT class_symbol_id, base_symbol_id, 1 AS depth
  FROM code.class_bases
  WHERE base_name = 'ApiModel'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.class_symbol_id, c.base_symbol_id, a.depth + 1
  FROM code.class_bases c
  JOIN ancestry a ON c.class_symbol_id = a.class_symbol_id
  WHERE c.base_name != 'ApiModel'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT class_symbol_id, depth
  FROM ancestry
  WHERE depth >= 2
  AND class_symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT class_symbol_id
    FROM code.class_bases
    WHERE base_name = 'ApiModel'
  )
)
SELECT class_symbol_id, depth
FROM filtered
ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: The query first builds the full inheritance tree starting from any class that directly names ApiModel as a base (depth 1). It then recursively follows other base classes to find indirect subclasses. The filtered CTE removes any class that directly lists ApiModel in its class statement (depth 1), keeping only those that inherit through at least one intermediate class (depth >= 2). Finally it selects the class symbol ID and the shortest chain depth to ApiModel.

WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
  SELECT class_symbol_id, base_symbol_id, 1 AS depth
  FROM code.class_bases
  WHERE base_name = 'ApiModel'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.class_symbol_id, c.base_symbol_id, a.depth + 1
  FROM code.class_bases c
  JOIN ancestry a ON c.class_symbol_id = a.class_symbol_id
  WHERE c.base_name != 'ApiModel'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT class_symbol_id, depth
  FROM ancestry
  WHERE depth >= 2
  AND class_symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT class_symbol_id
    FROM code.class_bases
    WHERE base_name = 'ApiModel'
  )
)
SELECT class_symbol_id, depth
FROM filtered
ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id
